1: # electron-clipboard-ex
2: 
3: A node.js native addon designed to use with [electron](https://www.electronjs.org/) to extend its clipboard features.
4: 
5: ![Travis](https://app.travis-ci.com/kenan2002/electron-clipboard-ex.svg?token=zab8ueZodq3Wkp6NTq2P&branch=master)

7: 
8: ## Example
9: 
10: Read file paths copied from macOS Finder or Windows explorer:
11: 
12: ```javascript
13: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
14: const filePaths = clipboardEx.readFilePaths();
15: ```
16: 
17: Write file paths to clipboard:
18: 
19: ```javascript
20: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
21: clipboardEx.writeFilePaths(filePaths);
22: ```
23: 
24: Clear clipboard:
25: ```javascript
26: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
27: clipboardEx.clear();
28: ```
29: 
30: Save clipboard image as jpeg:
31: ```javascript
32: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
33: // sync
34: clipboardEx.saveImageAsJpegSync(targetPath, compressFactor);
35: // async
36: await clipboardEx.saveImageAsJpeg(targetPath, compressFactor);
37: ```
38: 
39: Save clipboard image as png:
40: ```javascript
41: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
42: // sync
43: clipboardEx.saveImageAsPngSync(targetPath);
44: // async
45: await clipboardEx.saveImageAsPng(targetPath);
46: ```
47: 
48: Put image into clipboard:
49: ```javascript
50: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
51: // sync
52: clipboardEx.putImageSync(imagePath);
53: // async
54: await clipboardEx.putImage(imagePath);
55: ```
56: 
57: Check if clipboard has an image in it:
58: ```javascript
59: const clipboardEx = require('electron-clipboard-ex');
60: clipboardEx.hasImage();
61: ```
62:

64: This library supports Windows and macOS. Linux is currently not supported, feel free to open a pull request if you need it.
